dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Which one caught your eye? Every item here is unique. Every purchase here is a bargain!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: They were all purchased from the adventurers. Each of them represents the passion and courage of these adventurers—

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: So don't bother asking for a discount. You can never discount passion and courage!
